lyrics.text: Fold it in half, then fold it again
Mama is sleeping, I'm counting to ten
Machines in the corner keep singing their song
Beep after beep, Mama, hold on
Paper wings, paper wings
Carry my wish to the sky
A thousand paper wings
Don't let my mama die
She sang to me when I couldn't sleep
Now I sing to her and the song runs deep
Nine hundred cranes on the window sill
Time keeps moving but the room is still
Paper wings, paper wings
Carry my wish to the sky
A thousand paper wings
Don't let my mama die
Lord, I've been folding
Lord, I've been good
Lord, I would trade it all
If only I could
Paper wings, paper wings
Carry my wish to the sky
A thousand paper wings
Don't let my mama die
